scope: Calculator validation eligibility only; no predictions, refits, biological tests or threshold changes.
unrelatedness: No known family overlap after conservative connected grouping; not genomic proof of unrelatedness.
negative_definition: Lower-bound report-supported negative: signed original result, complete page marker, BRCA1 and BRCA2 sequence-variant rows all mapped to existing B/LB or VUS annotations, explicit normal copy-number results for both genes, and concordant existing registry-negative status. Not certified read-depth/callability or a new variant classification.
input_definition: Known nonconflicting age, diagnosis class, full grade, region, component-consistent TNBC and all eight family-history model inputs. Ki67 remains optional with the existing frozen missing-value rule. Ovarian markers are not transferred to breast tumors.
selection_rule: Lowest-BR family representative selected before core-input and report-outcome filtering; the previously disputed pair remains one family; missing/conflicting family IDs are not certified independent.
model_update_decision: Prepare and verify a retrospective validation dataset first. No coefficient, recalibration or cutoff change justified by record counts alone.
audit_stage: Conservative 51 prediction-date provenance review completed; none passes dated-input eligibility

historical_variant_source.title: Trujillano et al., Next-Generation Sequencing of the BRCA1 and BRCA2 Genes for the Genetic Diagnostics of Hereditary Breast and/or Ovarian Cancer
